top_signals.summary: The memorial gathering, the 24th of its kind, was held on the 81st anniversary of Soviet leader Joseph Stalin's secret order of internment issued on Aug. 23, 1945.

top_signals.title: NexG Slumps After Malaysia Rules Out $1.9 Billion Unit Buyout
top_signals.summary: Shares of NexG Bhd. fell the most in more than nine months after Malaysia’s government ruled out a potential acquisition of its unit Datasonic Technologies Sdn., which supplies the country’s passports and national identity cards.
